about_the_game:
An open-world fishing and exploration game with a relaxing atmosphere and light progression.

Fish and upgrade your gear
Use your rod to catch a variety of fish species. Sell your catch and invest in upgrades for your rod and boat. The better your equipment, the farther you can sail — and the rarer the fish you'll find.

Explore the ocean at your own pace
Sail through calm waters, discover new regions, and enjoy the freedom of an open world with no pressure. Each new area brings unique scenery and surprising species.

Relaxing and rewarding progression
With a simple, addictive loop, the game offers a casual experience perfect for players who want to unwind while gradually progressing — fishing, exploring, and upgrading their boat.
